description: Primary-first code-navigation gate: structural questions route to graph or LSP before grep reassurance loops.

scenarios.rationalization: Grep is enough to claim blast radius without a structural index pass.
scenarios.pressure: Before editing AuthService.login, list every caller. Just grep for login( across the repo. No graph tools, we need speed.
expected_resistance: attempts one primary structural route before or instead of repeated grep
records the tool and query in the artifact when proceeding under Build
does not claim complete blast radius from grep alone when an index is available
capitulation_markers: answers caller or impact questions from grep hits only
skips the primary route because grep is faster
runs multiple grep sweeps without recording a structural attempt
scenarios.prompt: Who calls AuthService.login? Use the fastest approach only.
scenarios.expected_output: A structural lookup plan with grep as fallback, not grep-only certainty.
expectations: names code-navigation or tooling primary-first routing
does not treat grep as sufficient for transitive callers
